notes: Refined existing stories to tighten scope semantics (deny-by-default, per-facade scope mapping, no-bypass guarantees) without creating new IDs.

change_log.value: Define allowlist contract with explicit scope domains (FindCare, EvaluateCare, Shared), tool-to-scope mapping, deny-by-default policy, and Pydantic validation hooks for pre-dispatch enforcement.
Implement validation engine that enforces tool name, scope domain, and payload schema; block out-of-scope or unmapped tools before any facade/service invocation.
Insert enforcement into tool_router path for all tool_use events with a single guarded entrypoint; ensure no alternate execution paths bypass validation.
Return standardized error codes/messages for scope violations (safe for LLM), and log structured audit events without leaking internal mappings or secrets.
change_log.note: Add error codes and safe disclosure constraint
